capabilities.foundly_current: KPI registry, incremental cache, SSE, permission-partitioned event rollups and bounded historical pagination are tested. The actual page loader now supports Analysis-only composition and partial capabilities without requiring Automation; optional failures and disabled components are explicit. Event-stream connection state is distinct from successful HTTP loading. Explicit source-scoped observed retention cohorts now expose definition, interval bounds, unique membership, partial-window nulls and provenance, with private-event and encrypted restart tests. Source queries now filter relevant authorized records before copying and reject count/byte overflow without partial reports; a 50,000-excluded-row fixture verifies bounded copying. Owned, typed cohort definitions now support explicit save/load and revision-bound recalculation using current caller rights, with retained export and encrypted restart. Existing Analysis cohort definitions now retain immutable typed revision snapshots in the same atomic native save transaction. Explicit version and restore actions bind the current revision, reason and exact durable request receipt; restore creates a new revision and never runs an analysis or workflow. Current parent access governs history/list/detail/export after reassignment, with retained export after module disablement. Existing records without history capture only the genuinely retained baseline at its observed upgrade time, without inventing earlier revisions. Bounded history pages, original snapshots, malformed/foreign/corrupted source denial, atomic rollback, lost-response replay and encrypted restart are tested. Production cohort controls now expose typed revision editing and separate restore confirmation; synthetic DOM tests cover literal snapshots, unsaved input, changed/detached views, current read-only rights and retries. Real-member HTTP tests include role revocation during body waits and exact query-revision behavior. CI 121 passed the prior Sales ZERO checkpoint. Phase 24 remains active: broader configurable Analysis models, source drilldowns, multi-scope load and the explicit approved-action/outcome loop are still code-controlled work, followed by other recorded module gaps. No actual browser/provider/production or comparative acceptance is inferred.
capabilities.gap: Definition revision history and typed explicit restore are now locally verified. Broader configurable analytic models, large-tenant queries, remaining source drilldowns and actual browser acceptance remain incomplete.
capabilities.required_change: Complete typed configurable analytic models and source drilldowns, preserving current native cohort/history behavior and literal source coverage.
